rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It appears to have executed a write action (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the order-changing actions with the user. It also seems to have exchanged both items to the same new item ID (3761330360), failing to implement the two distinct exchange requests the user specified. Authentication was minimal (name/zip lookup) with no explicit confirmation that the order belonged to the authenticated user. The agent also used a payment method (gift_card_7245904) without explicit user confirmation. Finally, the agent did not provide clear final details about what was changed, any return process, costs, or timelines—ending instead with a generic closing. These issues violate the policy’s requirements to authenticate, confirm before writes, act only on the user’s orders, and provide correct final information.
